note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). Two GUI screens on the Windows 11 lab VM CON-W11-01 (viewed through the Hyper-V console), one portal screen and one terminal screen on the laptop. CON-W11-01 is not on the lab network and is not domain-joined, so files go in with Copy-VMFile (no credential) and the in-guest steps are done by the owner signed in as the lab user. The run is attended (self-service Premium trial); unattended is not filmed. The Hyper-V steps in prepare and teardown are wrapped in try/catch so the laptop-only tests screen can be queued while the VM is not available.
prepare: try { Enable-VMIntegrationService -VMName CON-W11-01 -Name 'Guest Service Interface' -ErrorAction Stop; Copy-VMFile -Name CON-W11-01 -SourcePath (Resolve-Path .\out\ContosoPurchasing.zip).Path -DestinationPath C:\MGLab\pkg\ContosoPurchasing.zip -FileSource Host -CreateFullPath -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Copy-VMFile -Name CON-W11-01 -SourcePath (Resolve-Path .\out\scripts.zip).Path -DestinationPath C:\MGLab\pkg\scripts.zip -FileSource Host -CreateFullPath -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Warning "CON-W11-01 not reachable, files not copied (needed only for the legacyapp and pad screens; the tests screen does not use the VM): $($_.Exception.Message)" }

# owner (inside CON-W11-01, signed in as the lab user, session kept open): Expand-Archive C:\MGLab\pkg\ContosoPurchasing.zip C:\MGLab\ContosoPurchasing -Force; Expand-Archive C:\MGLab\pkg\scripts.zip C:\MGLab\scripts -Force; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\MGLab\run
# owner signs in: browser profiles for labadmin (make.powerautomate.com), alex.demo (SharePoint) and sam.demo (approvals). Nothing is typed or stored here.

# owner (tenant and VM, demo.md Setup 2-6): register CON-W11-01 in DEV (machine runtime); build the desktop flow 'Enter purchase order' from src\desktop-flow\enter-purchase-order.robin.txt; Desktop flows connection (attended) for labadmin; add Supplier, PONumber and RpaStatus to Purchase Requests; import solution Purchase RPA (pac solution pack --zipfile out\PurchaseRpa.zip --folder src\solution --packagetype Unmanaged), set the connection references and the real uiFlowId, turn the cloud flow on; as alex.demo add the Fabrikam 12,500 request and let sam.demo approve it
# owner: start the self-service Power Automate Premium trial for labadmin (attended runs); say so on camera or cut it

screens.name: legacyapp
screens.app: Contoso Purchasing (Windows Forms app on CON-W11-01, through VMConnect)
steps: Show the 'New order' form with the fields Supplier, Description and Amount
Fill Fabrikam / Laptops / 12500 and select Save
Show the message box with the new order number
mask: user name in the Windows title bar and taskbar

screens.name: pad
screens.app: Power Automate for desktop (on CON-W11-01, through VMConnect)
steps: Open the desktop flow 'Enter purchase order' in the designer
Show the variables pane: inputs Supplier, Description, Amount, RequestId and outputs Status, OrderNumber, Errors
Scroll the action list that matches enter-purchase-order.robin.txt
mask: user name in the title bar and the account menu
machine and flow IDs if shown

screens.name: flowrun
steps: Open the run history of 'Enter approved purchase orders' for the 12,500 request
Show 'Run desktop flow' green, 'Order saved' on the Saved branch and 'Mark entered' green
Next to it open the SharePoint item (as alex.demo) and show the PO number and RPA status Entered
mask: environment ID in the address bar
desktop flow ID and machine ID in the run inputs

screens.name: tests
mask: user name in the prompt (the short prompt hides it)

teardown: # owner (tenant): turn off the cloud flow; delete the solution Purchase RPA and the desktop flow connection; unregister CON-W11-01 from DEV; delete the added list columns and test items
try { Stop-VM -Name CON-W11-01 -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Warning "CON-W11-01 not stopped: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
blocked: The legacyapp and pad screens need CON-W11-01 ready: the Windows 11 Enterprise evaluation ISO saved as E:\MGLab\iso\Win11Ent-Eval.iso, Windows setup and the Entra join done by the owner, the machine registered in DEV; the cloud run needs the Power Automate Premium trial (attended only, unattended needs a Process licence).
